channel.title: Wire — Engineering
channel.description: Engineering from thirty sources, one digest a day.

item.title: Presentation: Teaching Engineers, Trusting AI: How Education Enabled Autonomous Code Review
item.description: Sarah Deitke discusses how Duolingo drives cultural AI adoption beyond tooling access. (1 source: infoq)

item.title: Have it both ways: stay discoverable in search while disallowing AI training
item.description: Cloudflare is giving site owners a way to stay discoverable while disallowing AI training. New controls and an Accountable designation establish a shared model with Apple, Google, and Microsoft. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: Give every teammate and agent the right level of access to your Workers
item.description: You can now scope access to individual Workers and assign narrower Developer Platform roles, so teammates, CI tokens, and agents get only the access they need to debug, deploy, or monitor safely. (1 source: cloudflare)

item.title: What Stripe data shows about fraud at AI startups
item.description: We analyzed attempted fraud rates and customer abuse patterns on Stripe over the past year and found that AI companies faced 4.3x more fraud attempts than startups overall in Q3 2025. (1 source: stripe)
